title: aglaia macrocarpa
intro: Aglaia macrocarpa, commonly known as the Philippine Aglaia, is a plant species belonging to the Meliaceae family, native to the Philippines. The Philippine Aglaia is valued for its medicinal properties, which include reducing inflammation, improving cardiovascular health, and exhibiting antimicrobial activity. Its therapeutic actions are attributed to its ability to exhibit antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and anti-diabetic properties. The bioactive constituents of Aglaia macrocarpa include flavonoids, terpenoids, and triterpenoids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
